Usage: firebase functions:secrets:set [options] <KEY>

create or update a secret for use in Cloud Functions for Firebase

Options:
  -f, --force             automatically updates functions to use the new secret
  --data-file <dataFile>  file path from which to read secret data. Set to "-"
                          to read the secret data from stdin
  --format <format>       format of the secret value. 'string' (default) or
                          'json'
  -h, --help              display help for command
